$comment: Avenio skin (phase 2, 16 Nov 2026). Department-store sections live in avenio-layout (components/ly/home/sections/dept/); listed in its sections.json.
name: avenio
title: Avenio Department Store
description: A department-store Layout: a deals ticker, a department bar with five-column mega menus, an event band with department buttons, wide photo slides, deal rows, price-point tiles, brand tiles, a five-across listing with a filter drawer and colour prompt, and a two-column product page with size boxes, Add to bag + Buy now and pickup / delivery tiles. One wine-red colour family, crisp 4/8 px corners, DM Serif Display over Figtree.
summary: Department-store Layout: deals ticker, mega menus, event band, deal rows, price tiles, brand tiles, five-across listing, two-column product page.

shop.name: fashioni
shop.$homeNote: The shop's Home is page 31218 (Page Builder). Set home=shop on avenio.selldone.shop only (selldone_shop_home_domain_set), never on the shop default.

palettes.$dark: family near-black grounds (Garnet about #1a0a0e), white words, the action colour lifted to the family 300; the ticker becomes the family 900 with 100 words

display.stack: "DM Serif Display", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
display.$use: wordmark, event headline, section titles, the one italic word in a headline; never prices

text.$use: everything else, prices and '% off' included (bold 700 for brand lines and prices)

shape.$language: crisp: buttons, fields, chips, size boxes, tiles and photos 4 px; panels, drawers, sheets and the mega menu 8 px; circles only for swatches, icon buttons and the heart. No capsules anywhere (the other Fashioni Layout is capsule-based).

en.bakini.n.co.within: Local delivery within {km} km of the store
en.bakini.n.rd.fq1: Can I order just one item?
en.bakini.n.rd.fa1: Yes. Every style is sold on its own: pick your colour and size, then add it to your bag.
en.bakini.n.rd.fq2: How do I order more than one of the same style?
en.bakini.n.rd.fa2: Add it to your bag, then press + beside it. Each press adds one more in the same colour and size, up to the number in stock.
en.bakini.n.rd.fq9: How do I find my size?
en.bakini.n.rd.fa9: Open "Size details" on the product page: it lists that style's own sizes and fit. If you are between sizes, write to us before you order: {reach}.
en.bakini.n.rd.fa9b: Open "Size details" on the product page: it lists that style's own sizes and fit. If you are between sizes, write to us before you order.
en.bakini.n.rd.fq10: Where can I see what a style is made of?
en.bakini.n.rd.fa10: On the product page, under "The details": the fabric, the care instructions and the other facts the shop lists for that style.
en.bakini.n.rd.pChoices: You can ask what details the shop holds about you, and ask for them to be corrected or deleted{ask}.
en.bakini.n.rd.pKeep: Order records are kept as long as needed for the order and for the shop's records. You can ask for your account details to be removed.
en.bakini.n.rd.pWho: The shop and the courier who delivers your order. Your details are not sold.
en.bakini.n.rd.tCancel: To change or cancel an order, write to the shop from your order page or by email as early as possible, before the order is sent.
en.bakini.n.rd.tFresh: Each product page lists the style's sizes, fabric and care instructions. If an item does not fit or arrives damaged, contact {shop} about a return or an exchange.
en.bakini.n.rd.tOrders: An order is a request to buy the items in your bag at the prices shown at checkout. The shop confirms each order on the order page. If an item is no longer available, the shop contacts you before sending the order.

ticker.label: Today's deals
ticker.lines: from live data: 'Up to N% off <department>' for the 4 departments with the deepest discount, plus 'Free pickup' / 'Delivery' only when the shop has that method

header.row: wordmark left · wide search field (4 px) · account · bag

departments.items: 'All departments' + every category with products, deals item last in the family colour
departments.menu: click opens (second click / Esc / outside closes); 5 columns: the department's products by type, by size or fit (from live 'type' sizes), featured brands, edits (New, On sale, Under $N), a promo photo card (col-<slug>)

listing.banner: compact (≤ 220 px): breadcrumb, category name in the display face, one line, the col-<slug> photo in a 4 px frame on the right; products visible on first load
listing.chips: a scroller of 4 px chips from live spec values (Occasion, Fit) or sibling departments
listing.toolbar: All filters (left drawer: Size, Colour, Price, Brand, Material, Fit, On sale) · quick buttons Size, Colour, Price, On sale · density 4 | 5 · Sort (Featured, Newest, Price ↑, Price ↓, Biggest saving, Most viewed, Top rated)
listing.grid: 5 across at 1440, 4 at 1100, 2 on a phone; card: 3:4 photo (contain on the family 50 plate), ♡ top-right, brand bold, name 2 lines, 'SALE' label in the family colour, price + '(N% off)', struck price, ★ only with ratings, colour dots (+n), 'Choose size' / 'Add to bag' outline button
listing.prompt: after row 3: 'What colour are you looking for?' panel with colour chips from the live variant colours (hex → nearest name)

product.gallery: vertical thumbnail rail + one large 3:4 photo, ♡ and zoom; phone: brand + name above a swipe gallery
product.buy: sticky column: brand, name, ★ (only with ratings), price + struck + '(N% off)', 'Colour: <name>' circles, 'Size: <x> · Size guide' 4 px boxes from 'type', Add to bag (solid) + Buy now (outline) side by side, 3 receive tiles (Pickup / Delivery / Shipping, only the shop's real methods), offers list only when real (coupons, cashback)
product.details: two columns: description + Features (pros) | Size & fit · Materials & care · Delivery & returns (from spec + shop policy); 'View full details'
product.rows: Similar items, More from <brand> (current product excluded)
product.bar: after the buy box scrolls away: Colour · Size · Edit + Add to bag + Buy now (scroll listener, not IntersectionObserver)

design.fallback: every photo slot falls back to a collage of that department's own product photos on the family 50 plate, so the Layout is complete with no photos
hidden: the shop description while it is Selldone's default text
categories with no products (Women, Men, Girls, Boys, Baby today) until they get products

homePlan.data: headline + 'Up to N% off' from the live max discount; department buttons = categories with products
each slide bound to a category (Dresses, Activewear, Footwear) with its live 'from $X'; pause button, progress fill, reduced motion
'Shop by department': 8 photo tiles, caption under, 'Up to N% off' line only when real
4 tall cards: NEW (newest), DEAL (deepest %), VALUE (lowest price), POPULAR (most viewed); real product photo, contain
'Great prices': tabs On sale / Under $25 / Under $50 / <dept> on sale + a tall family card on the left + a product row
'Shop by price': 4 tiles from live price quartiles, link to the listing with a price filter
'Deals by department': up to 3 rows (departments with the most discounted items), photo cards with the big '40% OFF' on a family plate
family pattern panel + headline + button | still-life photo; Bags & Accessories + Sunglasses
'Brands we love': typeset brand names (no logos), one row of 10, 'See all' opens the rest; each opens a search for the brand
'Don't miss these': Newest / Most viewed / Top rated (only with ratings) / Bags & accessories
two wide banners side by side: Jackets & Layers, Tops & Shorts
4 promise cards from real shop facts only (pickup, delivery ways, returns text, payment); a card with no fact is dropped
newsletter sign-up on the family dark, no promised discount
articles, date not reading time; always last
